page.title: Project
page.purpose: Organize a project into shots, source media and results while making privacy, spend and saved revisions visible.

priorities.statement: Choose the shot or result to work on.
Understand project privacy and budget before any external action.
Keep reusable assets separate from immutable shot revisions.

states.description: No operation is pending; identify the current task and available next action.
Work is acknowledged and queued or in flight with observed progress or an honest indeterminate state.
A safe retry is actively reconciling or executing without blind duplicate side effects.
Explain the current task, saved revision and next meaningful action.
Name what is loading; retain stable layout and existing local content.
Acknowledge the requested operation once and prevent duplicate costly submissions.
Distinguish local draft changes from durably saved revision; never claim saved early.
Explain local versus remote state and conflict resolution without silently overwriting edits.
Retain usable content and identify the specific information being refreshed.
Explain why there is no content and offer a relevant low-risk first action.
Show which inputs, output or services are available and which remain incomplete.
Show age, affected decisions and explicit refresh; never silently spend on refresh.
Confirm the concrete durable result and offer inspection or the next task.
Associate actionable correction with each invalid field while preserving input.
Explain the failed operation, preserved work and safe next action with diagnostic reference.
Identify the unavailable operation and authority boundary without requesting unrelated access.
Keep supported local work usable; mark online operations unavailable and never auto-submit paid work on reconnect.
Explain whether retry reuses an operation identity, reconciles prior work or starts a newly authorized operation.
Compare conflicting revisions and choose preserve-both or explicit resolution.
Keep existing results viewable and list affected source dependencies.
Show local supported work and the cap or funding reason affecting external tasks.

claims.statement: Shot edits create revisions and do not mutate released device or scene assets.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

claims.statement: Project summaries distinguish operator intent, agent authority and execution safety checks.
claims.rationale: Unimplemented design intent; runtime bindings, exact state setup, visual evidence and operator review remain required.

x-design.layout: Project title and saved state above shots and recent results; source bin and privacy/budget summary remain discoverable. Mobile uses ordered tabs instead of squeezed panels.
controls: Import recording/image/audio with duration, aspect and provenance inspection
Open project settings and source usage
Export portable project or publish a deliberate consumer handoff
details: A shot card identifies photographic or true-3D route and its preview/final capability.
Deleting a shared source lists affected shots and preserves outputs; explicit removal policy precedes destructive action.
Agent requests identify requesting agent, operation, revision, scope and owner approval boundary.

x-evidence-policy: No fake selectors, region bindings, setup hooks, captures or attestations. Planned controls are metadata until implemented and grounded.

x-implementation.stage: E1 UI capture complete; P3 media UI implementation in progress, acceptance pending
implemented: Load a real project by opaque ID
Rename against the revision observed when editing began
Typed stale-revision conflict with explicit reload
x-implementation.limits: PNG/JPEG media UI is in implementation and not yet accepted. Existing aspirational shot, recovery, privacy, budget, archive and search claims remain unimplemented. No release or whole-page claim is promoted by this annotation.
